analysis.reason: The API returned 404 with body {"message":"Requested item not found"} while the test expected 200 and a ProductResponse body. From the single execution result provided there is no evidence whether this is due to missing test data/environment setup (product id 1 not present), an incorrect test expectation (no contract guarantee that id 1 exists), or an application defect.
analysis.recommendedAction: 1) Verify test data: confirm that product with ID 1 should exist in the test environment and that the environment is correctly seeded. 2) Check API contract/docs to confirm whether the service guarantees existence of product ID 1 or if IDs are dynamic. 3) Inspect server logs for requests to /products/1 to see why 404 was returned. 4) Re-run the test after addressing test data/environment issues. If the item should exist and 404 persists, escalate as APPLICATION_DEFECT.
